name: S70 Ultra Short

livery.description: approximation of the red, white and blue wrap of UTA S70 cars (Red and Green lines)

sources.title: S70 Ultra Short Light Rail Vehicle – Salt Lake City, Utah (data sheet)

notes: Describes a consist of 2 coupled S70 Ultra Short vehicles. Per-vehicle figures (Siemens data sheet): length over coupler 24.81 m, empty weight 43.771 t, 60 seats, approx. 225 total passengers at 6 p/m2, 4 doors per side, 2 wheelchair spaces, traction 4 x 130 kW, maximum operational speed 88 km/h, service acceleration and deceleration 1.34 m/s2, emergency braking 2.18-2.2 m/s2, minimum turning radius 25 m. Consist totals (length, weight, seats, total, doors, wheelchair spaces, power) are per-vehicle values multiplied by 2 (marked derived); width, height, speeds and rates are per vehicle. Capacity is per consist; per vehicle it is 225. The data sheet says the vehicles can run in multiple-unit consists of up to four. Each vehicle is double-articulated (three sections, Bo'+2'+Bo'). 70% low-floor; floor height 356 mm is the low-floor threshold (high-floor section 855 mm). Height left null because the data sheet's metric height (43771 mm) is evidently a misprint. Maximum allowable speed 95 km/h.
